description: Source code for Kubernetes RBAC v1beta1 client, providing interfaces and functions to interact with RBAC resources such as roles and role bindings within the Kubernetes API.

classes.name: RbacV1beta1Client
classes.description: Client for interacting with RBAC v1beta1 resources in Kubernetes.

methods.name: ClusterRoles
methods.description: Returns an interface for managing cluster roles.

methods.name: ClusterRoleBindings
methods.description: Returns an interface for managing cluster role bindings.

methods.name: Roles
methods.description: Returns an interface for managing roles within a namespace.

methods.name: RoleBindings
methods.description: Returns an interface for managing role bindings within a namespace.

methods.name: NewForConfig
methods.description: Creates a new RBAC v1beta1 client from a given configuration.

methods.name: NewForConfigAndClient
methods.description: Creates a new RBAC v1beta1 client from a configuration and HTTP client.

methods.name: NewForConfigOrDie
methods.description: Creates a new RBAC v1beta1 client from a configuration, panics on error.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new RBAC v1beta1 client from an existing REST client.

methods.name: setConfigDefaults
methods.description: Sets default values for the REST configuration.

methods.name: RESTClient
methods.description: Returns the REST client used to communicate with the API server.
